study type: Cost analysis using a decision tree model, based on data from a randomized controlled trial
outcome: infant's length of stay in postnatal ward or NICU
cohort: Infants diagnosed with neonatal hypoglycemia in the first 48 hours after birth.
finding: Treating neonatal hypoglycemia with dextrose gel resulted in an overall cost saving of NZ$1314.44 per infant compared to standard care.
mod_finding: Dextrose gel remained cost-saving even with wide variations in cesarean delivery rates.
